boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten documented no-cost ways to share art, music, ideas, and outdoor time at Hamilton College, with public and campus-only access clearly distinguished.

cards.entity_name: Ruth and Elmer Wellin Museum of Art
cards.title: Browse the Wellin Museum Together
cards.subtitle: A free gallery outing at Hamilton’s campus museum
cards.notes: Meet in the lobby, explore the current exhibition at your own pace, and compare favorite works in the second-floor lounge afterward.
cards.short_summary: A conversation-friendly art hang with free admission and no required purchase.
cards.evidence_claim: Hamilton states that Wellin Museum entry is free, its programs carry no charge, and the museum is open to everyone.
cards.source_title: Location and Hours — Wellin Museum of Art
cards.access_notes: Free and open to everyone. The museum is closed for installation through August 17, 2026; consult the page for updated academic-year hours.

cards.title: Join the Outing Club Crew
cards.subtitle: No-charge membership based at Glen House
cards.notes: Join the listserv at Glen House or by email, then watch for campus trips and seasonal equipment opportunities suited to your experience.
cards.short_summary: A free way for Hamilton community members to connect around organized outdoor activities.
cards.evidence_claim: Hamilton says anyone in the Hamilton College community can join the Hamilton Outing Club at no charge.
cards.access_notes: Restricted to the Hamilton College community. Join through the HOC listserv or at Glen House; individual trips may have separate requirements.

cards.entity_name: Hamilton College Arboretum Saturday Speaker Series
cards.title: Catch a Saturday Garden Talk
cards.subtitle: Free public sessions in Kennedy Auditorium or online
cards.notes: Bring a friend to a Saturday session, take notes on practical garden ideas, then continue the conversation during an arboretum walk.
cards.short_summary: A free morning program pairing expert talks with an optional campus landscape stroll.
cards.evidence_claim: Hamilton states that every Saturday Speaker Series event begins at 10 a.m. and is free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Free and open to the public. Sessions are offered in Kennedy Auditorium and online via registration; 2026–27 details are still forthcoming.

cards.title: Share a Common Ground Discussion
cards.subtitle: Free public dialogue events at Hamilton
cards.notes: Attend with a friend, listen for where the speakers agree and differ, and trade takeaways after the moderated discussion ends.
cards.short_summary: A no-cost evening built around civil discussion of consequential public questions.
cards.evidence_claim: Hamilton identifies Common Ground’s main events as free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Main events are free and open to the public. Check the official page for the next announced speaker, date, venue, and any registration instructions.

cards.title: Open the Semester with Faculty Music
cards.subtitle: September 4 in Wellin Hall at Schambach Center
cards.notes: Meet before the recital, settle in for solo works spanning several instruments and voices, and compare standout performances afterward.
cards.short_summary: A free faculty recital offering an easy early-semester group outing.
cards.evidence_claim: Hamilton’s 2026–27 performing-arts page lists the September 4 Fall Faculty Concert among music events for which all admission is free.
cards.access_notes: Scheduled for 7:30 p.m. September 4, 2026, in Wellin Hall at Schambach Center. The department states that all listed music events have free admission.

cards.title: Hear a Story Unfold in Song
cards.subtitle: September 19 in Wellin Hall at Schambach Center
cards.notes: Invite a friend to follow the recital’s path from opera to contemporary musical theatre, then discuss how the program shaped its story.
cards.short_summary: A free voice-and-piano recital organized around one artist’s journey through the arts.
cards.evidence_claim: Hamilton lists Renee Heitmann’s September 19 recital within its music-event section and states that all events in that section have free admission.
cards.access_notes: Scheduled for 7:30 p.m. September 19, 2026, in Wellin Hall at Schambach Center; admission is free.

cards.entity_name: Family Weekend Department of Music Concert
cards.title: Gather for the Family Weekend Concert
cards.subtitle: September 26 at Schambach Center
cards.notes: Bring classmates or visiting family to hear Hamilton ensembles share one program, then regroup outside to swap favorite musical moments.
cards.short_summary: A free ensemble concert designed for an intergenerational campus gathering.
cards.evidence_claim: Hamilton includes the Family Weekend Department of Music Concert in the section where it states all music events have free admission.
cards.access_notes: Scheduled for September 26, 2026, at Schambach Center. Hamilton states that all department music events listed on the page have free admission.

cards.title: Meet Up for the Jazz Festival Finale
cards.subtitle: October 24 in Wellin Hall at Schambach Center
cards.notes: Arrive together for the festival’s evening finale, listen for each guest artist’s contribution, and trade observations after the set.
cards.short_summary: A free concert of original music and jazz standards featuring visiting performers.
cards.evidence_claim: Hamilton’s current arts calendar marks the October 24 Jazz Festival Concert as free admission and open to off-campus guests.
cards.access_notes: Scheduled for 7:30 p.m. October 24, 2026, in Wellin Hall at Schambach Center. Free admission; open to off-campus guests.

cards.title: Watch the Fall Dance Concert
cards.subtitle: November 6–7 at Schambach Center
cards.notes: Choose either evening with friends, watch how faculty and guest choreography uses the stage, and compare interpretations afterward.
cards.short_summary: A free student-dance outing with two scheduled evening performances.
cards.evidence_claim: Hamilton’s current arts calendar lists the November 6 and 7 Fall Dance Concert performances as free admission and open to off-campus guests.
cards.access_notes: Performances are scheduled for 7:30 p.m. November 6 and 7, 2026, at Schambach Center. Both are free and open to off-campus guests.

cards.title: Spend a Sunday with Solo Piano
cards.subtitle: February 21 in Wellin Hall at Schambach Center
cards.notes: Plan a quiet Sunday meetup around the recital, listen for connections across the program, and linger afterward to exchange impressions.
cards.short_summary: A free afternoon piano performance that works well as a low-key shared cultural outing.
cards.evidence_claim: Hamilton’s 2026–27 Performing Arts Series lists Asiya Korepanova’s February 21 piano recital with free admission.
cards.access_notes: Scheduled for 3 p.m. February 21, 2027, in Wellin Hall at Schambach Center. The official listing specifies free admission.
